tables.caption: The sequence and properties of NCRs and the derivatives used in this study
footnotes: Bactericidal index more than 0.225 was predicted to have antimicrobial activity based on AMPA program.

db_assertions.db_measure: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (37.14%) to Arenicin-3 analog N3. V: 14%; C=K=R: 11%. Activity: killed K. pneumoniae (60% at 3.125 uM; 100% at 25 uM) but not S-aureus MRSA at 25 uM. Warning: Nonstandard assays, killing in PBS for 18 h followed by plating and overnight growth on MHB plate. Warning: other bacteria not tested. Inhibited biofilm formation 30% at 5 uM (48 h). In vitro toxicity: human RBC: <20% hemolysis at 100 uM after 16 h incubation (less hemo.lytic).

Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (42.86%) to Arenicin-3 analog N3. K: 25%; C: 17%. Activity: killed K. pneumoniae (>60% at 12.5 uM) but not S-aureus MRSA at 25 uM. Warning: Nonstandard assays, killing in PBS for 18 h followed by plating and overnight growth on MHB plate. Warning: other bacteria not tested. Inhibited biofilm formation ~30% at 5 uM (48 h). In vitro toxicity: human RBC: ~50% hemolysis at 100 uM after 16 h incubation (HC50 100 uM).

Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (65.71%) to NRC094. K: 25%; C: 17%. Activity: killed K. pneumoniae (>60% at 12.5 uM) but not S-aureus MRSA at 25 uM. Warning: Nonstandard assays, killing in PBS for 18 h followed by plating and overnight growth on MHB plate. Warning: other bacteria not tested. Inhibited biofilm formation <30% at 5 uM (48 h). In vitro toxicity: human RBC: <10% hemolysis at 100 uM after 16 h incubation (less hemo.lytic).

Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (91.43%) to NRC094. V: 14%; S=K=R: 17%. Activity: killed K. pneumoniae (~100% at 12.5 uM) but not S-aureus MRSA at 25 uM. Warning: Nonstandard assays, killing in PBS for 18 h followed by plating and overnight growth on MHB plate. Warning: other bacteria not tested. Inhibited biofilm formation 90% at 5 uM (48 h). In vitro toxicity: human RBC: no hemolysis at 100 uM after 16 h incubation (not hemo.lytic).

Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (34.78%) to RC-101. C: 19%. Activity: killed K. pneumoniae (>80% at 12.5 uM) but not S-aureus MRSA at 25 uM. Warning: Nonstandard assays, killing in PBS for 18 h followed by plating and overnight growth on MHB plate. Warning: other bacteria not tested. Inhibited biofilm formation 30% at 5 uM (48 h). In vitro toxicity: human RBC: >60% hemolysis at 100 uM after 16 h incubation.

Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (47.62%) to NRC992. C=M=R: 20%. Activity: killed K. pneumoniae (>80% at 12.5 uM) but not S-aureus MRSA at 25 uM. Warning: Nonstandard assays, killing in PBS for 18 h followed by plating and overnight growth on MHB plate. Warning: other bacteria not tested. Inhibited biofilm formation 90% at 5 uM (48 h). In vitro toxicity: human RBC: >60% hemolysis at 100 uM after 16 h incubation.

Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (52.38%) to NRC992. C=Y: 18%. Activity: killed K. pneumoniae (>70% at 12.5 uM) but not S-aureus MRSA at 25 uM. Warning: Nonstandard assays, killing in PBS for 18 h followed by plating and overnight growth on MHB plate. Warning: other bacteria not tested. Inhibited biofilm formation ~60% at 5 uM (48 h). In vitro toxicity: human RBC: >60% hemolysis at 100 uM after 16 h incubation.
